command: set -e; SDK="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}}"; APKSIGNER="$(find "$SDK/build-tools" -maxdepth 2 -type f -name apksigner | sort | tail -1)"; test -x "$APKSIGNER"; APK=artifacts/releases/v2.0.10/local-climate-link-v2.0.10-android-release.apk; echo RELEASE_APK_CERT; "$APKSIGNER" verify --print-certs "$APK" | grep -E 'Signer #1 certificate SHA-256 digest|Signer #1 certificate DN'
